This is the boring PC that is absolutely AWESOME! 

We’re focusing on:
• Price-to-performance over aesthetics
• Same-tier CPUs and GPUs — just not the overpriced variants
• Practical cooling instead of boutique hardware
• Airflow over RGB
• Performance per dollar over flex
